cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — lying on her front; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — standing; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; a candlelit gala dinner hall — seated on a chair; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — standing close to a high shelf or line; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — standing; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground
